reference.title: HTTP示例
reference.shortdesc: 本节主要介绍HTTP相关的操作流程，其中包含实例创建、通用参数配置、GET/PUT/POST请求等相关流程。

section.title: 创建实例和参数设置
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCREATE="http://120.27.12.119:10080" //创建实例 +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0,"Connection: close" //报头设置（根据实际需求设置） OK AT+MHTTPCFG="header",0 +MHTTPCFG: "header",0,19,Connection: close OK AT+MHTTPHEADER=0,0,1,"api-key: FC9B69m4prHH2j7ljBbA=hHlbMI=" OK
section.note: 请求前可进行通用参数配置。

section.title: GET请求
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,1,1,/get" //GET请求 OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,225,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:18:46 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 145 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,145,145,145,{"args":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"0","Host":"localhost:6000"},"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/get"}

section.title: POST请求
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,1,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}" //content设置 OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,2,1,"/post" //POST请求 OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,220,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:25:23 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 278 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,278,278,278,{"args":{},"data":"{\"id\":\"speed1\"\\r,\"tags\":[\"mobile\"],\"unit\":\"m/s\"\\r,\"unit_symbol\":\"m/s\"}","files":{},"form":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"70","Host":"localhost:6000"},"json":null,"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/post"}

section.title: PUT请求
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,1,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}" //content设置 OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,3,1,"/put" //PUT请求 OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,220,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:26:42 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 277 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,277,277,277,{"args":{},"data":"{\"id\":\"speed1\"\\r,\"tags\":[\"mobile\"],\"unit\":\"m/s\"\\r,\"unit_symbol\":\"m/s\"}","files":{},"form":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"70","Host":"localhost:6000"},"json":null,"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/put"}

section.title: Chunked模式下的POST请求
section.msgblock: AT+MHTTPCFG="chunked",0,1 //设置为chunked模式 OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,2,1,"/post" //发送POST请求 OK AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,1,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}" //发送content数据 OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,220,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:25:23 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 278 Connection: close Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,278,278,278,{"args":{},"data":"{\"id\":\"speed1\"\\r,\"tags\":[\"mobile\"],\"unit\":\"m/s\"\\r,\"unit_symbol\":\"m/s\"}","files":{},"form":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"70","Host":"localhost:6000"},"json":null,"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/post"}
